text: It all starts when rent falls due on a Monday
First thing I do is check the bank feed in Xero
Then I copy anyone who hasn't paid into my own arrears spreadsheet
Sometimes the bank feed is a day behind so it looks like people haven't paid
If they're more than a week late Dean has to approve a breach notice
It's usually about fifteen rooms a week
Right, and how long have you been doing it that way?
Actually that's not a spreadsheet, it's a list in the property software
I'm not sure who follows up after the notice goes out
Add a decision after the bank feed check: has the tenant paid
The bank feed is always a day behind on Mondays
Then we send the tenant a reminder text
The tenant usually pays by bank transfer
That happens because the bank only updates overnight
Nobody really knows how disputes get sorted out, it depends who picks it up
